$comment: P2 loop-to-green cloud playbook. Gate name (as it appears in check runs) -> recipe. 'fix' runs at repo root via bash -lc; a recipe MUST verify its own fix locally before returning 0. 'owner_action' gates are reported, never attempted. Recipes carry the provenance of the session that derived them (2026-09-19).

gate-p2next-rail-count.why: C5: a satisfiable unit carries no independent PASS. As of a0f775fd0 the only such unit is IMP-0435 (both-states CI evidence exists: red run 35449511219 job 105914109160 head 86be7d74d; green on heads 3b9bcd0c4+). The r3 promotion is a review action performed by a fresh-context reviewer, not a mechanical recipe — if it has not landed by the time this runs, promote per the protocol below ONLY after re-verifying both runs from the API.
gate-p2next-rail-count.message: review(IMP-0435): r3 promotion after API-verified both-states evidence (red 35449511219 / green heads; per FIXPLAYBOOK protocol)

gate-tests-coverage (python packages).why: Layered gate: pytest tools/command-center, validate --require-complete, render --check, casualty suite+guard+redproof, measure-guard battery, receipt admission gate, unitgate. Each layer only runs once the previous is green, so fixes unmask the next. Session-proven recipes:

layer_recipes.numpy-missing: pip install pytest numpy (mechanism_dedup_gate.py imports numpy at module level)
layer_recipes.casualty-elided-digest-mismatch: re-pin declared digests to fixed points over LF-stable bytes (see commit 86be7d74d method); verify with verify_elided_digest.py MATCH=True both
layer_recipes.jsonparse-unparseable: make stub .json fixtures valid JSON objects (rename collides with deliberate .md twins); untrack leaked selftest artifacts under _r2_tmp/
layer_recipes.unitgate-schema-invalid-receipts: fill report.kind/control_ids/observations from the receipt's OWN evidence (kind enum: claim-record/work-unit; observations[].measured must be scalar); nothing invented

gate-tests-coverage (python packages).message: fix(p2-cloud): python-packages layer per playbook recipe

gate-interpreter-floor.why: py3.11 floor: f-string expressions may not contain backslashes (py3.12+ syntax).
gate-interpreter-floor.message: fix(p2-cloud): hoist backslash out of f-string expression (3.11 floor) per playbook

gate-lint-format (ruff).fix: uvx ruff@0.15.17 check --fix --quiet . ; uvx ruff@0.15.17 format --quiet . ; uvx ruff@0.15.17 check . && uvx ruff@0.15.17 format --check .

gate-no-runtime-junk.why: Tracked runtime junk (gitlinks, node_modules/__pycache__ paths, installed.json). gitignore alone does NOT untrack — the 0ebc468aa pathspec-commit trap restored them.
gate-no-runtime-junk.fix: git ls-files | grep -E '^\.worktrees/' && git rm -r -q --cached .worktrees/* || true; python command-center/p2-loop/untrack_junk.py && python .github/workflows/no-runtime-junk-junkscan.py 2>/dev/null || true
gate-no-runtime-junk.message: fix(p2-cloud): untrack runtime junk (plain staged-index commit; never pathspec)

gate-unit-artifact-manifest.why: Registered artifact bytes changed without a manifest re-pin, or a setup-action SHA typo (5fda3d95 vs 5fda3b95 class).

gate-mcp-audit.why: r4-eol part-C control anchored to the retired *.ps1 eol=crlf policy; the control lives in the probe's throwaway repo (A6) since IMP-0017's all-LF policy.

gate-secrets (gitleaks).why: Full-history scan; synthetic fixture identifiers get finding-level exact-value waivers (plural [[allowlists]], regexTarget=secret) after a 401-invalid probe proves the value synthetic. NEVER waive a live secret.
gate-secrets (gitleaks).message: fix(p2-cloud): gitleaks finding-level waiver per playbook (synthetic-proven only)

github-advanced-security.why: GitHub's own agentic code-scanning dynamic workflow dies on a server-side model rejection (CAPI 400 'model not supported', sweagent-capi:claude-opus-5). No repo change can fix it. Re-run once; if persistent remove from required checks or file a support ticket citing request ids 1C42:29ADD0:19CEF26:1FD54A4:6AAE869A / 6400:3C6EBC:1B6CB5E:227CAAB:6AAE7A5E.
